Which Odoo does this phone report to?
Enter your Odoo address, starting with https://, for example https://your-company.com. Without /odoo or a trailing slash.
It is the address you open Odoo at in the browser: copy it from the address bar up to /odoo.
What is this phone called in Odoo?
Enter the device identifier exactly as it is in Odoo, with the same capitals. Letters, digits and - _ . ~ only, no spaces.
Remote → Devices → New. Choose the Mobile Phone category, set the Identifier (for example PHONE-ANA) and save. That same Identifier goes here.
Which key does this phone sign in with?
Paste the token Odoo generated for this device. Every phone has its own: do not use another phone\'s.
On the device, the Generate Token button. Odoo asks for your password and shows the token once, with a copy button: copy it and paste it here.
No spaces: letters, digits and - _ . ~ only
